item.title: Multi-Agent Flow Matching with Decoupled Generative Guidance
item.description: Generative modeling is widely used for producing diverse objects from complex, multimodal distributions. item.title: IMPACT: Modeling Socially Interdependent Movement in a Generative Multi-Agent Simulation of a Pompeian Household
item.description: Simulations of archaeological sites can make interpretations of past cultural practices observable and examinable. item.title: doPlan: A Variable-Horizon Dataset for Multi-Stage Language-Conditioned Planning in Autonomous Driving
item.description: Autonomous vehicles interacting with passengers through natural language must reason beyond immediate commands. item.description: World-action models (WAMs) jointly predict how a scene will evolve and how an agent should act, however joint generation alone does not necessarily impose a shared geometric constraint on these predictions. item.title: ExceptionDrive: A Planning-Oriented Counterfactual Corner-Case Benchmark for Autonomous Driving

item.title: Context Language Models
item.description: We introduce Context Language Models (CLMs), language models that natively manage their own context. We implement this by treating the context as a file and allowing the model to make unrestricted updates to this file. This allows the model to learn what is most important to maintain in context, and naturally extends to multi-agent systems where multiple agent contexts coexist as files. item.title: RAVEN: Receiver-Conditioned Action-Value Encoding for Finite-Alphabet Multi-Agent Communication
item.description: A message drawn from a small alphabet helps a teammate only if it keeps the distinctions that change that teammate's next decision. item.title: Towards Spatial Perception for Heterogeneous Robot Collaboration in Subterranean Mining Environments
item.description: The autonomous extraction of deep mineral deposits in abandoned underground mines is fundamentally a multi-agent integration problem. item.title: DROM: A Language-Guided Diffusion Framework for Multi-Skill Robotic Manipulation
item.description: Learning robust manipulation policies for diverse, long-horizon tasks from limited demonstrations remains a fundamental challenge in robotics. item.title: PowerMarketJax: A JAX Benchmark Suite for Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning in Power Markets
